note_ko: 1인 포즈 라이브러리. 키는 BASE_POSES 이름. 팔다리는 관절 순서(body → arms → legs → feet → head)로 한 번씩만. 좌우 대신 one/other, 상대는 없음. legs(무릎·정강이)는 3/4 전신 이하(depth>=5)에서, feet는 전신(depth>=6)에서만 쓰인다. gaze가 있으면 그 포즈가 시선을 고정하고 엔진 시선 문장은 빠진다. 기준 문서: docs/1인포즈_작성기준.md

편안하게 서기.desc_ko: 어깨 힘을 뺀 기본 선 자세

parts.body: standing upright with {p} shoulders relaxed
parts.arms: {p} arms hang loosely at {p} sides
parts.legs: {p} weight is even over both legs
parts.feet: {p} feet are about hip width apart
parts.head: {p} head is level

한쪽 다리에 기대 서기.desc_ko: 한쪽 다리에 체중을 싣고 골반이 살짝 기움

parts.body: standing with {p} weight on one leg and {p} hip shifted slightly to that side
parts.arms: one hand rests in {p} pocket while {p} other arm hangs relaxed
parts.legs: {p} other knee is softly bent
parts.feet: {p} free foot rests lightly on its toes
parts.head: {p} head tilts a little

벽에 기대 서기.desc_ko: 어깨와 등 윗부분을 벽에 가볍게 기댐

parts.body: standing with {p} shoulder and upper back resting lightly against the wall
parts.arms: {p} arms are loosely folded in front of {p} chest
parts.legs: {p} weight rests on one leg
parts.feet: {p} feet are a little apart, one slightly forward
parts.head: {p} head tilts back toward the wall

난간에 기대기.desc_ko: 난간 옆에 서서 한 팔뚝을 난간에 얹음

parts.body: standing beside a railing with {p} body angled slightly toward it
parts.arms: one forearm rests on the railing while {p} other hand hangs relaxed
parts.legs: {p} weight is on the leg farther from the railing
parts.feet: {p} feet are a little apart
parts.head: {p} head is level

parts.body: walking mid-stride with {p} torso upright
parts.arms: {p} arms swing loosely, one forward and one back
parts.legs: {p} front knee lifts slightly while the back leg pushes off
parts.feet: {p} back heel lifts off the ground
parts.head: {p} head is level and faces forward

parts.body: walking at an easy pace with {p} torso upright
parts.arms: {p} arms swing gently at {p} sides
parts.legs: {p} steps are short and relaxed
parts.feet: {p} front heel touches down first
parts.head: {p} head is level and faces forward

벤치에 앉기.desc_ko: 벤치에 등을 펴고 앉아 손을 허벅지에 올림

parts.body: sitting upright on a bench with {p} back straight
parts.arms: {p} hands rest on {p} thighs
parts.legs: {p} knees are together
parts.feet: {p} feet rest flat on the ground
parts.head: {p} head is level

parts.body: sitting back comfortably into the sofa with {p} shoulders relaxed
parts.arms: one arm rests along the armrest while {p} other hand lies in {p} lap
parts.legs: {p} legs are folded to one side
parts.feet: {p} feet are tucked in beside {o}
parts.head: {p} head rests lightly against the backrest

의자에 앉아 읽기.desc_ko: 의자에 앉아 책을 펼쳐 들고 읽음

parts.body: sitting in a chair with {p} back against the backrest
parts.arms: {p} hands hold an open book at chest height
parts.legs: {p} knees are bent and together
parts.feet: {p} feet rest flat on the floor
parts.head: {p} head is bent slightly toward the page

책상에 앉아 공부하기.desc_ko: 책상 앞에서 몸을 살짝 숙이고 펜을 든 채 공부함

parts.body: sitting at a desk leaning slightly forward
parts.arms: {p} forearms rest on the desk, one hand holding a pen over an open notebook
parts.legs: {p} knees are under the desk
parts.feet: {p} feet rest flat on the floor
parts.head: {p} head is bent toward the notebook

바닥에 앉기.desc_ko: 바닥에 허리를 펴고 앉아 손을 무릎에 올림

parts.body: sitting on the floor with {p} back straight
parts.arms: {p} hands rest on {p} knees
parts.legs: {p} knees are bent
parts.feet: {p} feet are drawn in toward {o}
parts.head: {p} head is level

무릎 꿇고 앉기.desc_ko: 무릎을 꿇고 엉덩이를 발뒤꿈치 위에 올려 곧게 앉음

parts.body: kneeling upright with {p} hips resting on {p} heels
parts.arms: {p} hands rest on {p} thighs
parts.legs: {p} knees are together on the floor
parts.feet: {p} shins and the tops of {p} feet are flat on the floor
parts.head: {p} head is level

바닥에 다리를 뻗고 앉기.desc_ko: 바닥에 앉아 두 다리를 앞으로 쭉 뻗음

parts.body: sitting on the floor with {p} back upright
parts.arms: {p} hands rest on the floor beside {p} hips
parts.legs: {p} legs are stretched straight out in front
parts.feet: {p} feet are relaxed with the toes pointing up
parts.head: {p} head is level

다리를 꼬고 앉기.desc_ko: 한 다리를 다른 다리 위로 꼬고 편하게 앉음

parts.body: sitting back comfortably
parts.arms: {p} hands rest on {p} lap
parts.legs: one leg is crossed over the other at the knee
parts.feet: {p} upper foot hangs relaxed
parts.head: {p} head is level

창가에 서기.desc_ko: 창 가까이에 서서 한 손을 창틀에 얹고 밖을 봄

parts.body: standing near a window with {p} body angled toward it
parts.arms: one hand rests on the window frame while {p} other arm hangs relaxed
parts.legs: {p} weight is even over both legs
parts.feet: {p} feet are about hip width apart
parts.head: {p} head turns toward the window
parts.gaze: {p} eyes look out through the window

창가에 앉기.desc_ko: 창턱 근처에 편하게 앉아 한 손을 창턱에 올림

parts.body: sitting comfortably near the window sill
parts.arms: one hand rests on the sill while {p} other hand lies in {p} lap
parts.legs: {p} knees are drawn up a little
parts.feet: {p} feet rest on the edge of the seat
parts.head: {p} head turns slightly toward the window

가볍게 스트레칭.desc_ko: 두 팔을 머리 위로 올려 깍지 끼고 곧게 서서 스트레칭

parts.body: standing tall in a simple stretch
parts.arms: {p} arms are raised overhead with {p} fingers interlaced
parts.legs: {p} legs are straight
parts.feet: {p} feet are hip width apart
parts.head: {p} chin lifts slightly

요가 자세.desc_ko: 한 다리로 서서 합장하는 나무 자세

parts.body: standing in a balanced yoga pose with {p} spine long
parts.arms: {p} palms are pressed together at {p} chest
parts.legs: {p} weight is on one straight leg while the other knee turns outward
parts.feet: {p} raised foot rests against the inside of the standing leg
parts.head: {p} head is level

parts.body: running lightly with {p} torso leaning slightly forward
parts.arms: {p} elbows are bent and {p} arms swing opposite to {p} legs
parts.legs: {p} front knee lifts while the back leg extends behind
parts.feet: {p} back foot pushes off the ground
parts.head: {p} head faces forward

자전거 타기.desc_ko: 핸들을 잡고 몸을 살짝 숙여 페달을 밟음

parts.body: riding a bicycle with {p} torso leaning slightly forward
parts.arms: {p} hands grip the handlebars
parts.legs: {p} knees pump alternately
parts.feet: {p} feet rest on the pedals
parts.head: {p} head faces ahead
parts.gaze: {p} eyes look ahead along the road

기타 연주.desc_ko: 어쿠스틱 기타를 허벅지에 올리고 앉아 연주

parts.body: sitting upright with an acoustic guitar resting on {p} thigh
parts.arms: {p} fretting hand holds the neck while {p} other hand strums over the sound hole
parts.legs: {p} knees are bent with the guitar on the upper leg
parts.feet: {p} feet rest flat on the floor
parts.head: {p} head is angled slightly toward the strings

피아노 연주.desc_ko: 피아노 의자에 곧게 앉아 건반 위에 손을 올림

parts.body: sitting upright on a piano bench
parts.arms: {p} hands rest on the keys with the fingers curved
parts.legs: {p} knees are under the keyboard
parts.feet: {p} feet rest near the pedals
parts.head: {p} head is angled toward the keys
